title: Taiwan September Exports Jump 60.9% to $87.22B on AI Demand
summary:
Semiconductor shipments surged 46.1% year-on-year to $29.74B in September, propelling a rally in the island's trade performance. Overall exports rose 60.9% to $87.22B in September, reaching an all-time monthly high as Taiwan benefited from expanding artificial intelligence business and strong seasonal demand for technology goods.

IT and audio-visual exports, including AI servers, PCs, and graphics cards, jumped 103% to $39.13B, while electronics components rose 45.3% to $31.13B. Total semiconductor exports for the first nine months of the year reached $220.0B, up 47.3% from the previous year. Imports also reached a record $63.59B in September, a 51.7% increase.
